excerpt: Neutrinos play a crucial role in the collapse and explosion of massive stars, governing the infall dynamics of the stellar core, triggering and fueling the explosion and driving the cooling and deleptonization of the newly formed neutron star.
publisher: arXiv (preprint); A. Mirizzi, I. Tamborra, H.-T. Janka, N. Saviano et al. (8 authors)
title: Supernova Neutrinos: Production, Oscillations and Detection
